entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with VeloFit, my name is Bob. How can I help you today?
Hi Bob. I'm calling because I'd like to return my new VeloBand GPS Tracker.
No problem at all, I can definitely get that started for you. Just to confirm, when did you purchase it?
I received it right after it launched, around December 15th.

Okay, I see that here. You are well within the 90 days for our return period, so we can absolutely take care of that for you. I'm also seeing you're a VIP member with us, so thank you for your loyalty!
Oh, that's great news. So what do I need to do?
It's very easy. I'm generating a pre-paid return label and I've just sent it to the email we have on file for you. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, it just came through. Perfect.

Wonderful. Just print that return label, place it on the original box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Again, it's absolutely no problem.
Wow, that was incredibly simple. Thank you so much for your help, Bob.
You're most welcome! As a small thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's amazing. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
